Clearance decreases as renal function decreases, prolonging the elimination half-life and increasing exposure to the drug. A study recom- mended that dose adjustments be made for patients with creati- nine clearance (CC) less than 50 mL/minute; a 40% reduction to 60% of the starting dose was recommended for these patients.
